tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est.) remains carried and well above the Jun 22-23 compression zone. Renewed US-Iran strikes and tanker incidents have increased the risk that the conditional Iran-Oman traffic plan fails; no signed reopening is verified. Maintain protection at 60-70%. Stress (55%): iTraxx returns to 150-180bp if talks stall. Tail (40%): spikes to 200-230bp if strikes resume at scale. Only reduce on a confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF 79.45 EUR/MWh (Yahoo Finance, Sep 15) while official JKM remains $22.00/MMBtu carried (Reuters, Jul 24); the contextual JKM CFD reference was $25.06/MMBtu on Sep 14 (Trading Economics). The Iran-Oman traffic plan remains conditional and QatarEnergy force majeure is reported into early November. Keep the long-JKM/short-TTF thesis closed; a confirmed reopening would compress both markers, while renewed disruption would re-widen the spread.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

Maintain short PHP/IDR (long USD); re-enter long PHP/IDR only on confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation. Tail probability is 50%.
